prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

paragraphs.text: Configuration Specialist II, I’m drawn to the posting’s focus on translating documented business requirements into backend system configurations and on working cross‑functionally with implementation, product, and engineering teams. My four years as a systems architect have combined full‑stack builds with client‑facing onboarding, which aligns with the role’s need for precise, customer‑oriented configuration work.

I architected and deployed linkme‑intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface to manage high‑value subscription accounts. I constructed database‑layer automated data validation pipelines that cut transactional and invoicing errors by 98%, keeping configurations accurate and consistent. I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that reliably onboarded high‑value enterprise clients onto the core platform, turning business requirements into repeatable configuration workflows. I built the Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph pipeline that ingests job postings from public APIs, stores them in Postgres, and exposes a FastAPI service with a React/TypeScript dashboard; the system records all configuration changes in Git, producing complete change logs and passing a suite of 70 tests in CI.

One area where my background is lighter is provisioning and configuring customer accounts in a dedicated CRM system. To close that, I will finish CentralReach’s internal provisioning training, shadow a senior configuration engineer on live tickets, and practice the end‑to‑end workflow in a sandbox environment during the first month. I will also adopt Git for configuration change logs, as I have done on the Job Fit Agent project.
I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my build experience can support CentralReach’s configuration needs.
